messages:
Ramona Fields: Hey team — starting today on Mid-Market. Quick list: I need Salesforce seat, Gong + recording retention set for FedRAMP evaluation, access to the AE playbook, and the regulated-customer pitch deck. Who do I route these requests to? :wave:
Jonah Kim: welcome Ramona! :tada: SalesOps owns SF & Outreach, Revenue Ops owns Gong retention settings and pricebook access. I can kick off SF today — whatmail?
Ramona Fields: ramona.fields@redwood.ai — PST. Also cc'ing Legal cause of FedRAMP notes.
Priya Shah: Hi Ramona 64B Im Priya from RevOps. Gong retention for regulated customers is a special config (shorter retention, restricted exports). I'll need the customer NDA/engagement name to apply the policy.
Ava Lopez: LegalOps here 4DD. For FedRAMP-scope deals we require the standard DPA + data-processing addendum and an internal security checklist. Ping me the prospective account name and Ill pre-clear the recording language.
RevenueOpsBot: SYSTEM: Created ticket REVOPS-8342 for Gong retention policy change. Status: open.
Jonah Kim: SF ticket SOPS-9011 created. ETA: 4 hours once PeopleOps approves. I added Ramona to the AE queue and set role = "AE - midmarket".
Ramona Fields: Thanks — what exact wording do we put in invites for recorded calls with regulated customers?
Ava Lopez: Use the approved short consent: "This call may be recorded for quality and training. Redwood will retain recordings per customer agreement." I'll DM the full approved clause.
Priya Shah: Playbook: AE_Regulated_Playbook in Notion. You should have view access but not edit. If you need edit, tag @revenue-ops. Also sequences for regulated leads live under Outreach/Sequences/Regulated_AE.
Ramona Fields: I tried Notion but got 403 on the deck download (Pricebook_Regulated.pdf).
Jonah Kim: permission fix coming up. Hold tight.
RevenueOpsBot: SYSTEM: Permission change applied to Pricebook_Regulated.pdf. Ticket REVOPS-8342 updated.
Ramona Fields: Downloaded. One more technical: for Gong exports, can we turn off transcript export to users? We need only ops+compliance to access.
Priya Shah: yes, that's the standard. We'll limit transcript access to group: revenue-ops + security-compliance. Priya Shah: Note: exports still require a ticket for legal audits.
Ramona Fields: Awesome. Last ask: any quick CSV header template for bulk lead import into SF?
Jonah Kim: Use this: ```
email,first_name,last_name,company,job_title,lead_source,lead_status,owner,region
```
Ramona Fields: Perfect. Appreciate the speedy help everyone :pray:
Ava Lopez: Welcome aboard! We'll loop Legal on the FedRAMP doc and pre-clear the recording clause.
RevenueOpsBot: SYSTEM: Salesforce seat provisioned (SOPS-9011). Status: complete.
Ramona Fields: Got the SF invite and completed 2FA. All set to start prospecting.
